name: tech-tools
description: The atlas marketplace: a multi-agent coding architect (atlas) with 21 plainly named skills, 12 core agents, self-improvement hooks, and the atlas-orchestrate methodology (evidence before any done claim), plus an optional organizational deployment plugin (armada) with 4 invocable setup skills, 11 department agents, and 156 department skills.

plugins.name: atlas
plugins.description: Multi-agent coding architect: 21 plainly named skills (the atlas architect skill, atlas-orchestrate engine, atlas-audit code/architecture/self audits, atlas-doctor interactive self-improvement, atlas-setup onboarding/install/connectors/repair, atlas-loop recurring work, atlas-ux-test UX swarm, and 14 task skills), 12 core agents, 13 hooks including inline docs-drift warning, stale-connector-credential detection, self-improvement (session ingest, chronicle facet capture, memory capture, nudge) and atlas_doctor (session-health check), and the atlas-orchestrate method: deterministic contract tests as the verification step, with runtime evidence before any done claim, plus a shared multi-session local dashboard at http://127.0.0.1:7421/.

plugins.name: armada
plugins.description: Organizational deployment layer split out of atlas. Four invocable setup skills in run order: armada (deployment status and router), armada-brand (org name, voice, colors, commit style - run first), armada-department (activate one of 11 departments and its agent), armada-connect (vendor MCP connectors). Behind them: 11 department agents (data, design, engineering, finance, HR, IT ops, M365, product, productivity, security, support) and 156 department skills carrying org branding, policies, and compliance context. Install alongside atlas only for org use.

plugins.name: programmer
plugins.description: The Pragmatic Programmer (20th Anniversary Edition) as an active codebase auditor and coding-time advisor: 2 skills (tpp-audit runs a 10-dimension codebase review with file:line evidence; tpp-principles surfaces 1-4 relevant book principles while you work), 1 per-dimension auditor agent (tpp-auditor), a UserPromptSubmit nudge hook, and an 89-concept glossary repackaged as reference files for citation.
